text:
maria: FlashWave reporting sustained 429s since ~00:05 UTC. Saw a ~7k RPM burst for ~3m, then sporadic 429s. Escalating to support. Anyone seen similar pattern tonight? :eyes:
support_lead: @maria can you grab their gateway response headers (X-RateLimit-*) and which endpoint/model they're hitting? Also whether they're on hosted vs dedicated.
maria: Headers: Retry-After: 60, X-RateLimit-Limit: 6000/min, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0. Route: POST /v1/chat/completions, model: redwood-medium-13b, hosted plan.
kevin: That looks like an RPM cap hit not token TPM necessarily. Two quick suspects: minute-boundary alignment (many clients firing at the same second) or too many short-lived connections preventing multiplexing.
alex: Quick repro tip to customers: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/chat/completions -d @payload.json and inspect X-RateLimit-* in response. Ask them to log X-RateLimit-Remaining over time.
maria: Customer config: ~50 workers, each sending ~150 reqs/min, recently bumped concurrency. They open new HTTP/1.1 connections per request (no keepalive).
jordan: New connections + synchronized workers = "pulse alignment" on the minute. Recommend: enable HTTP/2 or keepalive/pooling, and avoid firing at exact minute boundaries. Also add jittered backoff.
alex: Short snippet we recommend for backoff (pseudo):
```
retry_delay = base * (2 ** attempts) + random(0, jitter_ms)
if header Retry-After present: sleep(max(header, retry_delay))
```
kevin: Immediate options: 1) Ask them to stagger jobs across a 60s window. 2) Enable persistent connections. 3) Add exponential backoff + full-jitter on retries. 4) If traffic steady-state needs >6k RPM, propose a quota bump or Dedicated capacity.
support_lead: Action: @maria please request their request pattern logs and the service key id. I'll open SUP-2389 for a temporary quota bump while they implement fixes. Also flag SRE if headers show per-token throttling.
incidents-bot: Created support ticket SUP-2389 and paged on-call @kevin.
maria: Customer accepted a 30m temporary bump and agreed to deploy keepalive + jitter changes. I'll follow up with logs and a before/after X-RateLimit timeline. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
